headline: Copper slides to its lowest level since June as the dollar firms
detail: LME three-month copper fell as much as 1.6% to about $13,019/t and COMEX settled near $5.99/lb on Nov 17, about 13% under the September record. A strong dollar, Fed hike bets and AI-stock jitters are pulling copper and copper scrap values lower.

headline: Ferrous scrap heads into December with strong mill demand
detail: SMU says ferrous markets look very healthy going into December, with all tracked grades up in November and sources seeing more lift before the January trade. Winter weather may slow obsolete flows and holiday shutdowns may cut prime supply, which supports a firm-to-higher December settle.

headline: Nucor lifts hot-rolled price for an 18th straight week to $1,310
detail: Nucor raised its weekly HRC spot price by $15 to $1,310 per short ton, with lead times at three to five weeks. Rising mill sheet prices keep EAF mills hungry for prime and shredded scrap.

headline: FOMC minutes due today with a December hike nearly fully priced
detail: Minutes of the Oct 27-28 meeting, where two officials wanted a hike, come out at 2pm ET; FedWatch showed about a 92% chance of a quarter-point hike in December. Higher rates and a stronger dollar have been the main weight on metals this month.

headline: US hot-rolled coil averages $1,390 as spot tons stay scarce
detail: SMU's HRC average rose $15 to $1,390/st, up $110 in a month, in what it calls the longest price rally in its records. Tight flat-rolled supply keeps mills running hard and supports scrap demand.

headline: Platinum drops to about a one-year low near $1,390
detail: Platinum fell roughly 2.5% to around $1,390/oz, down about 16% in a month, on a hawkish Fed, a strong dollar and weaker catalyst demand. That cuts what refiners pay for catalytic converters.

headline: LME cash aluminium jumps 5.7% in a near-term supply squeeze
detail: Cash aluminium rose $180 to $3,330/t on Nov 16 while the three-month price barely moved, leaving a wide backwardation. It points to a shortage of metal available now, which can support aluminum scrap and ingot pricing.

headline: China's October data miss on output, spending and investment
detail: Industrial output grew 4.8%, retail sales only 0.4%, and fixed-asset investment fell 8.1% for January-October, all weaker than forecast. Softer Chinese demand is a headwind for copper, iron ore and scrap export prices.

headline: COMEX copper slips under $5.90 as LME stocks build
detail: Copper futures fell below $5.90/lb on Nov 18, the weakest since May, as LME inventories climbed to around 320,000 t from about 205,000 t in August. Bigger exchange stocks ease supply worries and weigh on prices.

headline: Dollar index holds near its highest since April 2025
detail: The dollar index traded around 103.5 as markets priced a longer Fed hiking cycle after a third straight hot core CPI reading; the 10-year yield was near 5.13%. A strong dollar makes dollar-priced metals costlier for overseas buyers.

headline: Gold opens at its lowest since late September 2025
detail: December gold opened near $3,860/oz on Nov 17, down about 7% in a week, as rate-hike expectations and a firm dollar hit non-yielding assets. Weak gold reduces safe-haven support across precious metals.

headline: Strike drags on at Canada's largest copper mine
detail: More than 1,000 workers remain on strike at Teck's Highland Valley Copper in BC, and the provincial labour board has told the mine to stop using replacement workers. Lost output tightens concentrate supply, though it has not stopped copper's slide.

headline: China's October steel output hits a 10-month low
detail: Output fell to 70.83 million t, down 3.8% from September and 1.6% from a year earlier, as mill profits collapse. Lower Chinese production cuts iron ore demand but can also reduce cheap steel exports.

headline: Iron ore falls as Chinese port stocks build
detail: Dalian's most-traded iron ore contract fell 1.29% to 648 yuan/t on Nov 16, with port inventories up about 3 million t to 152 million t. Cheaper iron ore lowers costs for blast furnaces that compete with scrap-based mills.

headline: Steel buyers turn to imports as mill lead times stretch
detail: SMU's survey puts domestic hot-rolled lead times at about 9.7 weeks, the longest for most sheet products since 2021, with demand stable to improving. Long order books mean steady mill scrap buying into winter.

headline: October retail sales and factory output edge up
detail: Retail sales rose 0.2% and manufacturing output 0.3% in October, both slightly above forecasts, though inflation-adjusted sales fell. Steady factory activity supports industrial scrap generation and metal demand while keeping the Fed on track to hike.

headline: Nickel jumps nearly 4% on Indonesian supply worries
detail: LME nickel rose 3.76% overnight to $16,455/t, the only base metal to gain, on renewed fears of Indonesian supply disruptions; LME aluminium fell about 2%. Higher nickel lifts stainless and nickel-alloy scrap values.

headline: Platinum and palladium sold off hard on Nov 16
detail: Platinum fell about 3.1% and palladium about 3.5% on the day as Fed officials backed more rate hikes. Converter pricing tracks these metals closely, so cat values are under pressure.

headline: Palladium's deep discount to platinum tempts automakers
detail: Palladium near $1,000/oz trades about a third below platinum, which could push carmakers back toward palladium in catalysts over time. EV growth still trims long-term catalyst metal demand.

headline: Xi pitches free trade at APEC ahead of meeting Trump
detail: At the APEC summit in Shenzhen, Xi promised lower tariffs and wider market access and was set to meet Trump on Nov 18; no trade deal had been announced yet. Any US-China trade thaw would help copper and other industrial metals.

headline: Homebuilder confidence falls to its lowest since 2012
detail: The NAHB index dropped to 25 in November from 29, with 46% of builders cutting prices as mortgage rates stay above 7%. Weaker home building means less demand for rebar, copper wire and aluminum.

headline: Canada widens tariff relief on Chinese steel and aluminum
detail: After Carney met Xi in Shenzhen, Canada extended exemptions on 23 steel and nine aluminum tariff lines to the end of 2028. Washington has warned Canada about Chinese metal being routed into the US, so this could complicate US-Canada metals talks.

headline: Analyst expects 50% US steel tariffs to last at least eight more months
detail: An S&P Global analyst says the 50% Section 232 steel duty is unlikely to be lifted soon and sees US buyers shifting toward Mexican supply. Lasting tariffs keep domestic mill prices high and scrap demand firm.

headline: European recyclers push back on EU scrap export limits
detail: Recycling Europe warned that an EU list restricting which countries can import ferrous and aluminum scrap would depress European scrap prices. Less EU scrap on world markets could help US export scrap demand, especially into Turkey.

headline: Honda plans a $3 billion Ohio car plant
detail: Honda will build a plant in central Ohio adding 240,000 vehicles a year of capacity, with production targeted for 2029. More Midwest auto output means more prime busheling scrap and steel demand down the road.

headline: Silver steadies near $47.66 after a sharp monthly drop
detail: Silver was about $47.66/oz on Nov 17, roughly flat on the day but down about 17% from a month ago. Silver tracks both industrial demand and rates, so it is following the broader metals pullback.

headline: Canada presses Stellantis over sale of idled Brampton plant
detail: Canada's industry minister will meet Stellantis's CEO after the company moved to sell its Brampton, Ontario plant, idled since 2023, to an armored-vehicle maker. It shows continued pullback in North American auto capacity tied to tariffs and demand.

headline: Mercedes-Benz weighs closing German plants
detail: Mercedes reportedly halted new investment at its German sites and may close an assembly plant and a powertrain line if cost targets are missed. Weaker auto production abroad trims demand for aluminum, PGMs and steel.
